title: Minister Joe's special-needs youth group talks about the Hill

tellings.quote: he was saying that some of his uh kids in his youth group were talking about the hill

plain: Children in a special-needs youth group at a megachurch were talking among themselves about something they called "the Hill", according to their minister, a man known only as Joe. The documentary filmmaker Ky Dickens, maker of The Telepathy Tapes, repeats what Joe told her when she speaks with Michels, and she tells it because, if true, it suggests these children share an experience they could not have learned from each other in the usual way.
